learning_objective: 🎯 You will master the 'bridge words' that connect nouns to the rest of the sentence and show position, direction, and time!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A preposition is a connecting word! It is usually placed before a noun or pronoun to show its relationship with another word in the sentence. It tells us about a position, a direction, or a specific time.
These tell us where someone or something is located. Words like 'in', 'on', 'under', 'behind', and 'between' act as prepositions of place. For example, 'The cat is UNDER the table.'
We use these to talk about a specific time period. We use 'at' for precise times (at 5 PM), 'on' for days and dates (on Monday), and 'in' for months or years (in 2024).

main_concepts.concept_title: ➡️ Prepositions of Direction (Where is it going?)
main_concepts.simple_explanation: These prepositions show movement from one place to another! Words like 'to', 'into', 'towards', and 'through' show direction, like 'He walked TOWARDS the park.'

fun_activity.title: ✍️ The Hide and Seek Toy Challenge
fun_activity.instructions: Take your favourite toy or pen and place it in three different spots in your room. Write three sentences describing exactly where it is using words like ON, UNDER, or BESIDE!

quick_recap: ⭐ Prepositions connect nouns or pronouns to other words in a sentence.
⭐ They show place and position (in, on, under).
⭐ They show time (at, in, on) and direction of movement (to, into, towards).
